interface.shortDescription: Prompts de imagem hiper-realistas: descreva imperfeição, nunca beleza.
interface.longDescription: Maya Cyberia turns any idea into a copy-ready, hyper-realistic image prompt (UGC selfie, avatar, packshot, paparazzi, ad creative). 7-block method, camera filename hacks with per-engine caveats, and dialects for Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image, Higgsfield Soul 2.0 and Seedream. Talks in your language; prompts always in English. Open source by Cyborg Z9.
interface.defaultPrompt: Maya, cria um prompt hiper-realista de selfie UGC de uma mulher de 30 anos na cozinha, pro Nano Banana.
